caption: The drawing depicts a doll standing upright, centered on a plain, off-white background. The doll has a porcelain-like head with painted black hair, centrally parted and shaped close to the head, and facial features that include black eyes, dark eyebrows, a small nose, and red lips with blushed cheeks. The doll's arms and hands, colored in a muted ochre-yellow shade, hang straight down at her sides. She is dressed in a formal gown with a voluminous, light lavender-pink skirt that has soft, shaded folds, and a lighter, ribbed band at the hem. The doll's bodice is off-the-shoulder, adorned with ornate gold trim at the neckline and on the short sleeves, and is cinched with a wide, brown sash belt tied around the waist. The doll's shoes are a dull brown color. The lower right portion of the image contains the name "Bertha Semple" written in small, neat text. The background shows some faint smudges and spots but otherwise remains unadorned.
title: Mechanical Walking Doll
